message.content:
**Eiffel Tower – Height**

| Measurement | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| **Official structural height** | ≈ 324 meters (≈ 1 062 feet) |
| **With broadcast antennas** | up to ≈ 330 meters (≈ 1 082 feet) |

So depending on whether you include its modern antennas, the tower stands roughly between **1 060–1 080 feet tall**.
